Detailed Description

Simplify INT_SLESS applied to 0 or -1.

Forms include:

  • -1 s< SUB(V,hi) => -1 s< V
  • SUB(V,hi) s< 0 => V s< 0
  • -1 s< ~V => V s< 0
  • ~V s< 0 => -1 s< V
  • (V & 0xf000) s< 0 => V s< 0
  • -1 s< (V & 0xf000) => -1 s< V
  • CONCAT(V,W) s< 0 => V s< 0
  • -1 s< CONCAT(V,W) => -1 s> V
  • -1 s< (bool << #8*sz-1) => !bool`

Note that 0 s< -X => X s< 0 is not valid if X is maximally negative. There is a second set of forms where one side of the comparison is built out of a high and low piece, where the high piece determines the sign bit:

  • -1 s< (hi + lo) => -1 s< hi
  • (hi + lo) s< 0 => hi s< 0

virtual int4 ghidra::RuleSLess2Zero::applyOp ( PcodeOp * op,
Funcdata & data )
virtual

Attempt to apply this Rule.

This method contains the main logic for applying the Rule. It must use a given PcodeOp as the point at which the Rule applies. If it does apply, changes are made directly to the function and 1 (non-zero) is returned, otherwise 0 is returned.

Parameters
opis the given PcodeOp where the Rule may apply
datais the function to which to apply
